settings.existing_save_policy: Never initializes automatically. Disabling blocks diagnostic requests; native recovery preserves existing state. Never enable provisioning against an established gameplay save.
settings.bounds: Boolean only; any non-true value is disabled.
settings.internal_constants: One carrier, ground floor, 128 admin contexts, 1-second inspect throttle, 120-second confirmation expiry and file/identity bounds are diagnostic/safety limits, not gameplay balance.
